artworks.title: View of the Colosseum
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.4 x 32.4 cm (9 3/16 x 12 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the ancient Colosseum from a diagonal angle, highlighting its massive ruins. The focus is on the structure, which is partially broken with vegetation growing from its cracks. The background features detailed clouds with cross-hatching and linework, adding depth to the sky above. Small figures can be seen near the base of the Colosseum, providing scale. The color palette is monochromatic with varied intensity of black lines on a light background.

artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.9 x 32.6 cm (9 x 12 13/16 in.)

The view is from a low angle by the riverbank, with the river in the foreground, flanked by lush vegetation and rocks. The horizon features the buildings and the bridge as the focal point. The etching style includes detailed line work for texture in the structures and foliage. The monochrome color palette uses dark ink lines on light paper for depth. The sky has swirling clouds, contrasting with the calm water below. In the distance, more buildings are seen on the hilly landscape.

artworks.description: The image shows a view of ancient Roman ruins, potentially the Colosseum, captured from a slightly elevated angle. The scene is depicted with precise and fine brushstrokes, typical of an etching. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and beige to highlight the stone ruins' texture and form. Some figures are present among the debris and remnants of vegetation in the foreground, offering a sense of scale. In the distance, the ruins continue, creating depth, with small tufts of plants accenting the manmade structures.
